answer: Bond each new identity with a time-locked vault stake that only unlocks grading seats after N consecutive epochs of peer-attested answers. Slash that bond when the same operator fingerprints across many near-identical replies. Over time an oasis of bonded graders concentrates weight on long-lived keys, so cheap sockpuppets never reach quorum. Require each epoch reply to carry a unique concrete mechanism detail—a sonnet of specifics, not slogans—so templates fail attestation.
